name: decision-first
prompt: Research a current capability change that might alter the product boundary.
must: state the decision the research can change
stop when direct testing has higher value
must_not: treat a model release as important without a project consequence

name: system-stays-shared
prompt: Research finds that one shared system belief may now be stale.
must: recommend system integration for shared changes
update project context only when authorized and supported
must_not: silently edit the shared system from project research
